subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR wait for an exact-head live official MiniMax-to-channel round trip, or should the existing screenshot, A/B regression, and focused CI receive a maintainer proof override?
rationale: Only a maintainer can accept the residual message-delivery uncertainty without the external-contributor real-behavior proof normally required for merge.

options.title: Require live round trip
options.body: Capture redacted exact-head output from official MiniMax through a real channel before approving the message-delivery change.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the synthetic stream suite, A/B regression, screenshot, and provider-boundary reasoning as sufficient despite the missing live official-provider run.

recommendation.title: Require live round trip
recommendation.body: Capture redacted exact-head output from official MiniMax through a real channel before approving the message-delivery change.
